name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
provider: U.S. Department of State / Fulbright Commissions
amount: Award terms vary by participating country
duration: Typically one or more academic years

nationality: Most non-U.S. countries; check local commission
eligibility.other: Eligibility, fields, deadlines, and award terms are administered by the applicant's home-country Fulbright office.

description: Competitive international educational exchange program. Country-specific Fulbright offices publish authoritative eligibility and application cycles.

name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program
amount: $37,000 annual stipend plus $16,000 cost-of-education allowance, for each of three years of support
deadline_notes: Solicitation NSF 26-526, due 8:00 p.m. ET: 19 Oct 2026 Life Sciences; 20 Oct 2026 Computer and Information Science and Engineering, Materials Research, Psychology, Social Sciences; 22 Oct 2026 Engineering; 23 Oct 2026 Chemistry, Geosciences, Mathematical Sciences, Physics and Astronomy.
duration: Three years of support within a five-year fellowship period

nationality: U.S. citizens, nationals, or permanent residents
eligibility.other: Field eligibility, enrollment-stage rules, and deadlines are defined in the current solicitation. Approximately 1,500 fellowships are estimated.

description: NSF fellowship supporting graduate research in eligible STEM fields. Always confirm eligible fields and application requirements in the current solicitation.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
funding_type: Full or partial, depending on award route
amount: Check current program and university notice

nationality: International applicants; exact rules vary by route
eligibility.other: Application routes, degree availability, language, and deadlines vary by host university and bilateral program.

description: Government scholarship opportunities for study in China. Use the official portal and host institution notice to verify current terms. Applications are submitted through the Study in China portal.

name: Tsinghua University Scholarships

eligibility.other: Scholarship options and eligibility are published by Tsinghua's graduate admissions office.

description: Tsinghua's international graduate admissions lists scholarship routes including the Chinese Government Scholarship, the Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program, and program-specific full scholarships. Consult the current university guidance.

name: DAAD Study Scholarships
deadline_notes: The database index page does not publish deadlines; each programme's detail page states its own application requirements and dates.

nationality: Varies by program and country of origin
eligibility.other: Use DAAD's scholarship database with your country of origin and intended subject to find applicable calls.

description: DAAD maintains a searchable database of scholarships, including 'Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines' and 'Study scholarships for STEM disciplines'. Availability, eligibility, and benefits depend on the applicant's country and program.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters scholarships
university: Consortium of European and international universities
amount: Award conditions are set by the specific joint master's program
deadline_notes: Most programmes accept applications between October and January for courses starting the following academic year; each consortium sets its own dates.
duration: 1 to 2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS credits)

nationality: Worldwide applicants; individual program rules apply
eligibility.other: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or be in their final year of bachelor studies, and graduate before the programme starts. Scholarships are tied to specific listed joint master's programmes.

description: EU-funded joint master's programmes may offer full scholarships to the best-ranked students worldwide. Students apply directly to the institution running their chosen programme. The programme catalogue is updated annually.

name: Chevening Scholarship
funding_type: Fully funded (subject to current scheme conditions)
deadline_notes: Applications open in August 2026 and close in October 2026; the exact closing date depends on your country/territory page. Successful candidates must submit an unconditional UK offer by 17:00 BST on 8 July 2027.

nationality: Citizens of eligible Chevening countries or territories
eligibility.other: Applicants must meet current work-experience, course, and return-home requirements; check official eligibility page.

description: UK government scholarship for eligible future leaders to pursue a one-year master's degree in the UK.

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
amount: €1,200 per month at master's level or €2,100 per month at doctorate level (from January 2026); tuition fees are not covered
deadline_notes: Applications are submitted by French institutions, not by students directly. Check the annual call and the institution's own nomination deadline.
duration: Master's: up to 12 months (M2), 24 months (M1) or 36 months (engineering degree). Doctorate: 12 to 36 months.

nationality: Foreign nationals; age and prior-study rules apply
eligibility.other: Candidates are nominated by French institutions; applications sent directly by students are declared ineligible. Engineering Sciences is one of the seven eligible fields.

description: French government scholarship program for international students in eligible master's and doctoral fields. Applications are submitted exclusively by French higher education institutions.

name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and participating institutions
university: Participating Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences
amount: €5,000, paid in the first year of study; not a full-tuition scholarship
deadline_notes: Application opening and closing dates are set by each participating institution; the 2026-2027 round opened on 1 November 2025.

nationality: Non-EEA applicants, subject to current scheme rules
eligibility.other: Applicants must not already hold a degree from an institution in the Netherlands. Availability, value, and deadlines are determined by participating institutions.

benefits: One-off €5,000 contribution in the first year of study
description: Scholarship listed by Study in NL for non-EEA students at participating institutions. Verify the current participating institution offer.

name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
amount: Covers full study and living costs for the duration of the master's programme
deadline_notes: Application window: 1 November to 30 November 2026, 23:59 MEZ, for a start in the HS27 master's programme.

eligibility.other: For outstanding applicants to ETH master's programmes (no MAS); selection criteria are published by ETH.

description: ETH Zurich's competitive excellence scholarship for outstanding master's students, covering study and living costs. Check the current ETH application instructions and criteria.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
university: Participating Australian universities and TAFE institutions
amount: See country profile and current policy handbook
deadline_notes: Opening and closing dates are published per participating country.

nationality: Citizens of participating countries, particularly in the Indo-Pacific
eligibility.other: Eligibility and priority fields vary by participating country; check the relevant country profile. Scholars must leave Australia for a minimum of two years after completing the award.

benefits: Supplementary academic support and fieldwork travel where applicable
description: Australian government scholarships supporting full-time undergraduate or postgraduate study for people from participating developing countries. Country profiles define eligibility, fields, and application timing.

name: University of Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarships
deadline_notes: No separate application: applicants are automatically considered when they apply for a graduate research course by that course's closing date. Around 600 scholarships are offered.
duration: One or more years (fee offset up to 2 years Masters by Research / 4 years doctoral)

nationality: Domestic and international applicants; course and merit rules apply
eligibility.other: Applicants must have applied for and meet the requirements for a graduate research degree at the University of Melbourne, or be currently enrolled. Stipend awards are ranked by prior academic results and research potential.

benefits: Full fee offset (up to 2 years Masters by Research / 4 years doctoral)
Living allowance of A$41,100 per year pro rata (2027 full-time study rate)
Relocation grant of A$2,000 from other Australian states/territories or A$3,000 from outside Australia
Overseas Student Health Cover (single membership) for international students
description: University of Melbourne research scholarship options for eligible graduate researchers, including the Melbourne Research Scholarship and Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarship. Confirm current award terms and application route.

name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
provider: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
funding_type: Full scholarship (subject to country and scheme eligibility)
amount: See current scholarship eligibility and benefits guidance

eligibility.other: Eligible countries, study levels, subjects, and application windows are country-specific; verify using the official eligibility checker.

benefits: Travel and establishment support per scheme terms
description: New Zealand government scholarships for people from eligible partner countries. The programme covers undergraduate and postgraduate study plus thematic and vocational short-term training. Use official country and eligibility guidance before applying.

name: University of Canterbury International First Year Scholarship
amount: See current award page for value and conditions
duration: First year, subject to award terms

nationality: International students meeting current award rules
eligibility.other: Check current eligibility, deadlines, and eligible undergraduate programmes on the official scholarship page.

description: University of Canterbury scholarships for international students entering their first year of undergraduate study. Check the current page for award details.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Renewable Energy and Sustainable Construction (RESCO)
provider: Erasmus Mundus consortium (Hungary, Spain, Portugal, France)
university: Four European institutions in Budapest, A Coruña, Braga & Guimarães, and Le Havre
amount: See the programme's fees and scholarships page
deadline_notes: The first application campaign for the 2026 intake opened on 25 November 2025, and the programme announced 'RESCO Admissions 2026 Closed!' on 19 May 2026. Dates for the next intake were not published when this record was checked.
duration: Two years across four European institutions

nationality: Worldwide applicants; Erasmus Mundus rules apply
eligibility.other: Delivered across Budapest (Hungary), A Coruña (Spain), Braga & Guimarães (Portugal) and Le Havre (France), with a 4 to 6 month internship in Europe or worldwide.

description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master training professionals in renewable energy systems and sustainable construction, delivered by four European institutions in Hungary, Spain, Portugal and France.

name: European Master in Earthen Architecture and Construction (TERRA)
provider: Erasmus Mundus consortium (Portugal, Spain, France, Italy)
university: Partner institutions in Guimarães, Valencia, Lyon and Florence
amount: Scholarships support costs up to €25,800; the programme tuition fee is €9,000
deadline_notes: Three calls for the 2026/2027 edition: 15 February 2026 (first call, the only call offering EU scholarships), 30 April 2026 (second call), 15 June 2026 (third call). All three had passed when this record was checked, although the programme homepage still advertises the third call as open. The European Union has funded TERRA for five editions.
duration: Each academic year runs September to July

language_requirements.english: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 72, or TOEFL paper-based 525

eligibility.other: Applicants need a degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or equivalent: a bachelor's with 240 ECTS credits, or bachelor's plus master's totalling 300 ECTS (mandatory for mobility tracks including UNIFI). Two recommendation letters, a motivation letter, transcripts and proof of English proficiency are required.

benefits: 5% of all grants reserved for students with special educational needs
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master providing advanced training in sustainable earthen building and heritage conservation, delivered in Portugal, Spain, France and Italy. First edition runs in the 2026/2027 academic year.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master BIOPHAM — Bio & Pharmaceutical Materials Science
provider: Erasmus Mundus consortium of four European universities
deadline_notes: Two next application deadlines are published: 15 October 2026 and 13 November 2026.
duration: Two years, taught entirely in English

nationality: Worldwide applicants; Erasmus Mundus rules apply
eligibility.other: Theoretical and applied training in materials science and the physics of materials, applied to pharmaceuticals and biopharmaceuticals. The programme also documents alternative funding routes for applicants who do not hold a scholarship.

description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master providing theoretical and applied training in materials science and the physics of materials, applied to pharmaceuticals and biopharmaceuticals. Taught entirely in English.

name: International Master TFMASA — Transfers-Fluids-Materials for Aeronautics Sustainable Applications
university: Université de Bordeaux (FR); BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg (DE); UCLouvain (BE)
funding_type: Erasmus Mundus joint master (scholarship availability per call)
deadline_notes: No application dates were published on the programme homepage when this record was checked.

nationality: Worldwide applicants; Erasmus Mundus rules apply
eligibility.other: Course content covers fluid mechanics, materials science, aerospace structures, energy and propulsion systems, and engineering management. Taught across Bordeaux (France), Louvain-la-Neuve (Belgium) and Cottbus (Germany).

benefits: Joint diploma awarded by three European universities
description: Erasmus Mundus joint master in transfers, fluids and materials for sustainable aeronautics, taught across France, Belgium and Germany, with a materials science and composite structures core.

name: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
amount: Full tuition fees, a monthly allowance of SEK 12,000, and a one-time travel grant of SEK 15,000
deadline_notes: Published 2026/2027 cycle: master's applications through University Admissions ran 16 October 2025 to 15 January 2026; the SI scholarship portal was open 9-25 February 2026 and closes at 14:59 CET on the final day; the scholarship announcement was 23 April 2026. The call was marked closed when this record was checked.
duration: One- or two-year master's studies, beginning in the autumn semester

eligibility.other: Eligibility is restricted to citizens of the 34 listed countries. Applicants must be liable to pay tuition fees at a Swedish university, have applied through University Admissions, be admitted to an eligible master's programme on the admissions announcement day, and demonstrate both work experience (at least 3,000 hours for most listed countries) and leadership experience. Fields of study include STEM.

benefits: Full tuition fee coverage, paid directly to the university
Membership of the SI Network for Global Professionals
description: Swedish Institute scholarship for master's studies in Sweden, open to citizens of 34 listed countries. Covers a wide range of English-taught programmes, including STEM fields. Applications open once a year for studies beginning in the autumn semester.
